mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% for 3 months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the PCE inflation index above 2% for 3 months signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting market anticipation of higher interest rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or inflation remains below 2% for > 3 months post-signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a labor market tightening signal, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the drop in UNRATE is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in personal consumption expenditures above its 12-month moving average signals stronger demand, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the rise in GDPC1 is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% and a decline in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points in one month signals expansionary policy and labor market improvement, amplifying market optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% AND UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the combined signal does not materialize as expected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates stronger supply-side growth, boosting manufacturing activity and corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the increase in INDPRO is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% and persistent inflation below 2% for 3 months signals a soft landing, reducing policy uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 3.5% for 3 months AND CPIAUCSL < 2.0% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the conditions are not met in the regime context.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in personal consumption expenditures and industrial production above 5% growth in one month signals robust demand and supply-side expansion, driving corporate earnings and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 5% AND INDPRO rises > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the growth rates are not sustained.
